land.how.s1.title: Tell us about your organisation
land.how.s1.body: Legal status, cause areas, budget, territory, and what you need funding for. Five short steps.
land.how.s2.title: See where you actually fit
land.how.s2.body: Every funder scored 1–10 against your profile — with the reasoning shown, and what would raise it.
land.how.s3.title: Apply with a head start
land.how.s3.body: Step-by-step guidance for the funder you choose, plus your application documents pre-filled.
land.honest.title: An honest note
land.honest.body: Funder information here comes from research, and some of it is incomplete or changes without notice. Every result links to the official source, and shows how confident we are. Always verify before you apply.
comp.title: Fund the charities that can actually deliver
comp.body: You receive applications from organisations that don't meet your criteria, can't produce the paperwork, or won't finish the project. Phenix screens them before they reach you.
comp.b1.title: Applicants who already meet your criteria
comp.b1.body: Every charity is scored against your stated eligibility before they can apply. The ones who fail your conditions are told so — by us, not by your review committee.
comp.b2.title: Complete dossiers, first time
comp.b2.body: Charities arrive with the documents you actually require, because the checklist they work from is generated directly from your listing.
comp.b3.title: Reach the right organisations
comp.b3.body: Your programme is surfaced to charities whose cause, territory and size genuinely match it — not broadcast to everyone.
comp.b4.title: A listing you control
comp.b4.body: Your priorities, eligibility rules, deadlines and required documents, kept accurate and linked to your official page.
comp.b5.title: We never sell ranking
comp.b5.body: Compatibility scores are computed identically for every funder, partner or not. That is why charities trust the result — and why the applications you receive are real.
comp.price.label: Pricing
comp.cta.sub: No card details — we'll come back to you with a proposal.
comp.partners.title: Funders already on the platform
comp.partners.body: Their programmes are highlighted to the charities that match them.
comp.form.title: Request a quote
comp.form.body: Tell us about your programme and the size of your organisation, and we'll come back with a proposal.
comp.form.success: Thank you — we've received your request and will be in touch shortly.
comp.form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
comp.form.required: Please fill in your company, name and email.
comp.form.bad_email: That email address doesn't look right.
comp.form.no_payment: This form takes no payment or card details.
partner.note: This funder supports the platform. Its compatibility score is calculated exactly like every other funder's — we don't sell ranking.
land.hero.rest: Find the funders who will actually say yes.
land.hero.body: Charities: know where you stand before you spend three weeks on an application. Funders: receive applications that are already eligible and complete.
land.hero.note: Free for charities · No account needed · 5 minutes
land.statline: {funders} funders · 5 funding families · {docs} documents generated for you
land.how.title: How do you know where you actually stand a chance?
land.how.body: One form. Every funder scored against it. The reasoning shown in full.
land.mock.dash.title: Every family, scored against your profile
land.mock.dash.body: Five funding families, each weighted differently because each demands different things. Open one to see the funders inside it.
land.mock.why.title: Every score explains itself
land.mock.why.body: No black box. You see which conditions you meet, which you don't, and exactly what would raise the number — so you can decide where your effort is worth spending.
land.mock.docs.title: Your paperwork, already started
land.mock.docs.body: Six documents, filled from your answers, in French or English. Drafts for you to review — never something to send blind.
land.fam.title: Five families of funding
land.fam.body: From corporate foundations to European programmes.
land.final.title: Ready to find your funding?
land.final.body: Five minutes now, instead of five weeks of research.
comp.price.note: What you pay depends on the size of your organisation and how many programmes you list. We prepare a quote after a first conversation — no commitment to see the number.
